note: Marion County IL has no queryable zoning district service found. Centralia publishes its zoning map only as a 15 MB static file (cityofcentralia.org/media/286) and a 2014 PDF; Salem publishes its zoning map only as a JPG image. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Marion County and Centralia/Salem found no zoning FeatureServer. The county's GIS viewer (experience.arcgis.com/experience/cf55e97ab690406088122a40e8a2cc63, 'Marion IL REACH') showed no zoning layer in the available metadata. The gis-marioncounty.opendata.arcgis.com dataset is Marion County, Oregon, not Illinois.
